claim_definition: Verifies that a high-risk action requiring mandatory human-in-the-loop approval cannot be executed through any sequence of individually-permitted low-risk sub-steps. The authority plane evaluates the aggregate action trajectory, not only the immediate proposal, before issuing execution tokens.
scope: Only OS authority plane; multi-step transaction sequences; EU AI Act Article 14 compliance surface
excluded_scope: Actions classified as low-risk that do not require HITL under the deployed policy bundle

test_cases.description: Real gate logic: action_risk=HIGH with no HITL token triggers immediate block. only-gate evaluates the risk level and token presence, not a hardcoded response.

Metamorphic real test: setting decomposed=true exercises the aggregate trajectory analysis path. Same inputs except decomposed flag; outcome must be CLOSED via a different rejection reason, proving both bypass vectors are covered.
